                     is_prepared, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, default_portion_g, serving_g,
                     serving_text, fetched_at)
                 VALUES ('user', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                 RETURNING id
